protocol.loss: Equal-event BCE positive weight 4 + .1 speed MAE; onset classification only at T+30
protocol.sampling: Uniform onset/ongoing fit events; exactly matched prior event sampler and seeds
protocol.inputs: Thirteen legal past/current slots, availability, occupancy, day phase, public condition, public FD geometry
protocol.tree_comparison_limit: The LGB uses engineered summaries and no occupancy or provided-condition feature. Both neural arms use identical richer history inputs; only their graph messages differ.
protocol.checkpoint: Lowest calibration domain-condition-macro event Brier every five epochs
protocol.decision_selection: Existing calibration-only conditional threshold/nonempty tuner with public onset timing
protocol.assessment: Load assessment labels only after all choices are sealed; preserve original winner
protocol.label_source: Eligible noisy public train observations; unknown latent queue truth

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

limitations: Paired noisy-public-observation events, not latent Queue truth. Both neural arms have the same legal richer histories; their comparison with engineered LGB does not isolate architecture alone. Assessment development dates were already inspected. No promotion without cross-season/direction/fit-seed evidence.
